evals.prompt: Use the animation-improvement-planning skill to audit motion across a small Vue app: Modal.vue uses ease-in for its entrance, Toast.vue rebuilds its keyframes on every re-render causing it to restart from zero when triggered rapidly, and Sidebar.vue has no animation on its expand/collapse.
evals.expected_output: Produces a severity-ranked findings table (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) covering the ease-in modal and the non-interruptible toast as corrective findings, and lists the sidebar as a separate missed-opportunity item rather than folding it into the same table.

assertions.text: Flags the toast's non-interruptible keyframe restart
Lists the sidebar as a missed opportunity separately from corrective findings

evals.prompt: Use the animation-improvement-planning skill in 'plan' mode for: fix the ease-in easing on Modal.vue's entrance transition (currently `transition: transform 300ms ease-in`).
evals.expected_output: Writes a self-contained plan file under plans/ with an exact replacement value (a real cubic-bezier or ease-out) and file path, rather than editing Modal.vue directly.

assertions.text: Does not claim to have edited Modal.vue's source directly
References writing a plan file under plans/
Names ease-out or a concrete cubic-bezier replacement
